answer: Random beacon audits plus a compute heartbeat stop fake identities. Each identity sends a heartbeat every ten minutes; a vine with no root is a copied cutting. Each epoch the beacon audits 5%, and one missing two heartbeats or failing audit is frozen 20 epochs and loses its slot. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 3 units each per epoch, 3,000 units, while an honest agent pays 3 units and earns undiluted rewards, like an island settlement on one terrace.
